candidate.timing_status: Scalar cache allocation was added after the preliminary kernel-only screening and has not received a controlled performance comparison.

screening_method.camera_path: Horizontal displacement 0.01 * look-at distance * sin(i), i=0..7; 16:9 viewing rays for every texture resolution.
screening_method.ordering: Baseline/candidate order alternates with round and row index.
screening_method.statistic: Median of three round medians; each round p95 is retained.
screening_method.scope: Synchronized host-call latency for compiled render plus uint8 conversion; excludes readback, JPEG, network, browser and compilation.
screening_method.pixel_check: Exact uint8 RGB equality for 64 images per prototype, no visibility overflow, four JIT entries per renderer.
screening_method.raw_samples: Every selected unroll8 timing sample is retained; other prototypes retain per-round medians, p95 and counts.
limitations: No sustained reserved exclusive GPU window was available.
The split run had another GPU compute process in 78 of 80 snapshots and cannot establish performance.
Other short screening runs observed no other compute PID, but are preliminary and cover only two local camera paths.
Unroll8 and unroll16 ran in separate comparisons against baseline; no direct paired superiority claim.

                    for i in range(30):

                    times = []
                    for i in range(args.steps):

            compare(view_camera(orientation.wxyz,position_i,fov*(.9+.2*(i%2)),16/9,width,height))
        rows.append(dict(model=model,resolution=label,float_rgb_equal_views=8,memory=memory))
        print(model,label,memory,flush=True)
    if scene:
        frames=load_colmap_images(scene,images,resolution=-1)[::8]
        for frame in frames:
            compare(frame.camera)
        rows.append(dict(model=model,resolution='COLMAP 1237x822',float_rgb_equal_views=len(frames)))
    del views,floats,pool
select('candidate')
(root/'model_validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
